verdict.rationale: Reader does render pages in headless Chrome, selectable via `x-engine: browser`, so a viewport-size control is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence documents no header or parameter for setting viewport width or height. Related rendering controls such as `x-wait-for-selector`, `X-Locale` and engine selection are different features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control the browser viewport width and height when rendering a page
